Hardworking finish cheers for the cargo crew
A month with visitor flow in mind
Calm routes for companion travel

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has kept its focus on steady service, careful handovers, and clear notes in the ledger. <<FACT F008>> Our handlers continue to use calm, humane methods around animals, and the operations team is pleased to see each case reviewed with care when a service change is needed.

This month, travelers can expect orderly support from the first enquiry to arrival at the skyport. We will keep coordinating closely with passengers and ground staff so that each journey remains as smooth as possible. The desk remains committed to reassuring guidance, sensible planning, and respectful treatment for every companion animal entrusted to Aurelia Skyways.
